about: FA2-T8 K4 expected Inspector state per screen with a selection (hoan 67a05f5d), derived from the raw fixtures by the rules of UI.md 4.3, 4.4 and 4.5 without product code. The Inspector shows the state in the element with data-inspector-state (value = state, text = state text) and the issue count in the element with data-inspector-issues (value = count, text = issuesText).
rules: It reads web/prototype/data/ns-<namespace>.json and applies UI.md 4.3 / 4.4 / 4.5 by these
rules; it imports no prototype module and reads no DOM. The selection of each screen is
copied by hand from the screen table (packet 3.3) and the presets.
- Pods of a resource: the resource itself when it is a Pod, else every Pod whose parent
- Box of a bridge: the top of its source's parent chain (a Pod inside a workload belongs to
the workload's card). Rows of a box: one per (bridge kind, target); all service-pod
bridges of one Service share one target, the Pods it selects (UI.md 4.5 "one row per
target"). A row is broken when one of its bridges is.
- Broken links of a resource: its broken rows when it is a box (a top-level resource), else 0.
- State: the first of failing, unknown, progressing found among its Pods, with that Pod's
text; " · N broken link" is appended when it also has broken links (UI.md 4.3). Else
"attention" with "N broken link" when it has broken links, else healthy "Healthy".
- Issues (UI.md 4.3 propagation): Failing Pods plus broken links. Text "No issues",
- A selected link: its state, "Connected" or the UI.md 4.4 sentence; issues 1 when broken.
- A selected empty place (ghost): the state and sentence of the row that points to it.
